bounds.duplicated_frames: four explicitly listed fixtures per coefficient map and edge label
bounds.relative_domains: all four saturated domains of the chain
bounds.weak_squares: all pairs of S3 inner automorphisms for each of three coefficient maps

non_claims: Finite checks do not prove the arbitrary-category Lean theorems.
